spans.s:
(टु) टुक्षु r. 2d cl. (क्षौति)
To sneeze, to make any such sound.

m. (-णः)
The soap berry plant, (Sapindus saponaria.)
E.
क्षुद to bruise, डुण aff.

mfn. (-ण्णः-ण्णा-ण्णं)
1 Bruised, pounded.
2 Exercised, practised, skilful.
3 One versed in sacred science, but described as unable to explain or teach it.
4 Defeated, overcome.
E.
क्षुद to bruise, &c. affix क्त, form irr.

f. (-क्षुत्)
1 Sneezing; also क्षुत.
E.
क्ष to sneeze, affix क्विप्, तुक् is added.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sneezed, sneezing.
mf. (-तः-ता)
1

Sneezing.
2

Cough.
E.
क्षु to sneeze, affix क्त.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Sneezing.
E.
क्षु to sneeze, क्तवतु aff.

m. (-नः)
Black mustard.
E.
क्षुत sneezing, and अभिजनन what produces; also क्षुधाभिजनन.

f. (-री)
Black mustard.
E.
क्षुत् sneezing, करी making.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Hungry and thirsty.
E.
क्षुध् with तृष्णा thirst, and उपपीडित distressed.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Hungry and thirsty.
E.
क्षुध्, and पिपासा thirst, इतच् aff.

m. (-रः)
Allaying hunger, eating.
E.
क्षुध्, and प्रतीकार counteracting.

(ञ, इर, औ) औ क्षुदिर r. 7th cl. (क्षुणत्ति क्षुत्ते)
To pound, to bruise, to reduce to powder.

mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं)
1 Small, little.
2 Mean, low.
3 Mean, niggardly, avaricious.
4

Cruel.
5

Poor, indigent.
f. (-द्रा)
1 A woman maimed or crippled, wanting a limb, &c.
2 A dancing girl.
2 A whore, a harlot.
4 A fly.
5 A bee or wasp.
6 A gnat, &c.
7 A prickly nightshade: see कण्टकारी.
8 The egg plant, (Solanum melongena.)
9 Sorrel, (Oxalis monadelpha.)
E.
क्षुद to bruise or pound, Uṇādi affix रक्.

m. (-म्बुः)
A small shell.
E.
क्षुद्र small, and कम्बु a shell.

f. (-का)
A tinkling ornament, a girdle of small bells, &c.
E.
क्षुद्र small, घण्टा a clock or bell, affix कन्, and the fem. form.

m. (-डः)
A kind of small bird.
E.
क्षुद्र small, and चूडा a crest, small crested.

m. (-न्तुः)
1 Any small animal.
2 A kind of worm, (Julus.)
E.
क्षुद्र small, and जन्तु animal.

m. (-रः)
Small cummin.
E.
क्षुद्र small, and जीर cummin seed.

f. (-ता)
1 Smallness, minuteness.
2 Inferiority, insignificance, meanness.
E.
तल् added to क्षुद्र; also with त्व, क्षुद्रत्वं.

f. (-का)
A small gadfly.
E.
क्षुद्र, and दंशिका a gadfly.

f. (-शी)
A small gadfly.
E.
क्षुद्र, and दंशी a gadfly.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Having a little nose.
E.
क्षुद्र, and नासिका the nose.

f. (-त्रा)
Wood-sorrel, (Oxalis monadelpha.)
E.
क्षुद्र, and पत्र a leaf, small-leaved.

m. (-कः)
A tree, (Celtis orientalis): see जीवन.
E.
क्षुद्र, and फल fruit, कन् added, bearing a small fruit.

f. (-ला)
A plant, (Ardisia solanacea.)
E.
क्षुद्र, and फल fruit.

mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि)
Simple, silly, ignorant.
E.
क्षुद्र, and वुद्धि understanding.

m. (-गः)
A minor disease, one of little importance.
E.
क्षुद्र, and रोग disease.

f. (-शा)
A plant, (Dioscorea): see वराहक्रात्त्वा.

m. (-ङ्खः)
A small shell.
E.
क्षुद्र, and शङ्ख a shell.

m. (-र्षः)
A tree, (Celosia cristata.)
E.
क्षुद्र, and शीर्ष the head, having a small head.

f. (-हा)
A plant, commonly Mugāi: see मुद्गपर्णी.

f. (-का)
A prickly nightshade, (Solanum jacquini.) a small species.
E.
क्षुद्र small, and हिङ्गुली the plant.

f. (-ली)
See the last.

m. (-तः)
Small fry.
E.
क्षुद्र small, अण्ड an egg, मत्स्य a fish, and सङ्घात a heap.

m. (-सः)
A tree, (Artocarpus lacucha): see लकुच.

f. (-म्ला)
Wood-sorrel, (Oxalis monadelpha.)
E.
क्षुद्र, and अम्ल sour; a small and acid plant.

(ऋ औ) औक्षुधृ r. 4th cl. (क्षुध्यति)
To be hungry, to hunger.

f. (-धा)
Hunger.
E.
क्षुध to be hungry, affixes अङ् and टाप्.

f. (-क्षुत् or -क्षुद्)
Hunger.
E.
क्षुध to be hungry, affix क्विप्.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Causing hunger, improving the appetite.
E.
क्षुधा, and कर what makes.

m. (-सः)
Allaying hunger.
E.
क्षुधा, and ध्वंस destruction.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Hungry, starving.
E.
क्षुधा, and पीडित pained.

m. (-नः)
Black mustard.
E.
क्षुधा hunger, and अभिजनन causing, promoting.

m. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं)
Hungry, hungered.
E.
क्षुधा, and आर्त्त pained.

f. (-न्तिः)
Satisfaction, satiety, allaying hunger.
E.
क्षुधा, and शान्ति appeasing.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Hungered, hungry.
E.
क्षुध to be hungry, affix क्त.

m. (-नः)
A savage, a barbarian.
E.
क्षुध to be hungry, Uṇādi affix उनन्.

m. (-पः)
A small tree, one with short branches and roots, a bush, a shrub.
E.
क्षु to sound, aff. प.

mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्ध)
1 Agitated, tossed, stirred.
2 Agitated mentally, anxious, disturbed.
m. (-ब्धः)
The churning stick.
E.
क्षुभ to stir, to agitate, affix क्त, form irr.

r. 1st cl. (क्षोभति)
1 To be confused or agitated.
2 To stir or disturb.
r. 4th cl. and 9th cl. (क्षुभ्यति and क्षुभ्नाति)
To shake, to tremble, to be unsteady.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Frightened, alarmed, afraid.
2 Agitated, tossed, set in motion.
3 Agitated mentally, disturbed, anxious.
4 Angry, enraged.
E.
क्षुभ to shake, to be agitated, to stir, &c. affix क्त.

f. (-मा)
1 Linseed, (Linum usitatissimum.)
2 A sort of flax, Bengal

San.
3

The indigo plant.
4 A sort of creeper.
E.
क्षु to sound, affix मक्.

r. 6th cl. (क्षुरति)
1 To cut.
2 To scratch, to make lines or furrows.

m. (-रः)
1 A razor.
2 A plant, (Barleria longifolia.)
3 Also Tribulus lanuginosus: see गोक्षुर.
4 A horse's hoof; also खुर.
5 The hoof of a cow, &c.
6 The foot of a bedstead.
f. (-री)
A knife.
E.
क्षुर to scratch or cut, Uṇādi affix रन्, and the final consonant rejected; also खुर.

m. (-कः)
1 A plant, commonly

Tila.
2

Barleria longifolia.
3 Tribulus lanuginosus.
E.
क्षुर to scratch, &c. क्वुन् aff.

m. (-प्रः)
1 A kind of arrow, one with a horse shoe head.
2 A sort of hoe or weeding spade.
E.
क्षुर a hoof, and प्रथ to go, ड affix; also खुरप्र.

n. (-ण्डं)
A razor case.
E.
क्षुर, and भाण्ड a vessel.

m. (-र्द्दी)
A barber.
E.
क्षुर a razor, and मृद to destroy, affix णिनि.

f. (-णी)
A kind of yam: see वराहक्रान्ता.

mf. (-री-रिणी)
A male or female barber.
E.
क्षुर a razor, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं)
Little, small.
E.
क्षुद to pound, affix क्विप्, क्षुद powder, dust, ल from ला to get, to be, affix ड; also खुल्ल.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Little, small.
2

Hard.
3

Poor, indigent.
4 Low, vile.
5 Wicked, malicious, abandoned.
6 Young. [] youngest.
7 Pained, distressed.
m. (-कः)
A small shell.
E.
क्षुल्ल as above, and कन् added; also खुल्लक.

m. (-तः)
See the next.

m. (-कः)
A paternal uncle.
E.
क्षुल्ल youngest, and तात a father, कन् added.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Sneezing.
E.
क्षु, and मतुप् aff.
